# #24 — feat: list_recent should support offset beyond 200 or return total count

## Problem
list_recent caps at 200 results. During dream cycle cleanup, there were 400+ sessions and 290+ decisions -- entries beyond offset 200 were invisible to the initial scan. Had to manually paginate with offset parameter AND use search to discover entries that list_recent couldn't reach.

## Proposed Fix
Either:
1. Return a total_count field so callers know there are more entries to paginate
2. Support higher limits (500+)
3. Add a count_by_tier tool that returns tier distribution without fetching full entries

## Context  
Dream cycle 2026-04-09. Found 239 additional warm entries hiding beyond the first 200 that needed tier management.
